notes: geo_specificity drives ranking (schema rule R5): vancouver > bc > pnw > north_america > global.
baseline_confidence is the default confidence for a claim extracted from this source before any review.
url_verified=false means the URL is the known domain and must be checked when the first claim is extracted.
licence is recorded so extraction stays within terms; MOBOT and OSU are educational/non-commercial; KPU has its own copyright page; Pojar is a book — structured excerpts with page numbers only.
licence_tier: A = open data, import; B = cite facts, never copy text; C = do not import, link only (kpu, aspca). Checked per source on licence_checked; see HANDOFF §4 and methods.md M8.

Plant Finder publishes a citation format (FAQ #1144): (Plant), Missouri Botanical Garden Plant Finder, URL, Accessed (date).

sources.licence_note: Non-commercial academic use. Only structured values are stored, with the published citation; no sentences copied. 'Re-published in electronic form' is about their text/images, not facts — Kay to confirm this reading.

sources.name: City of Vancouver Public Trees (Open Data)
sources.licence: Open Government Licence – Vancouver (https://opendata.vancouver.ca/pages/licence/) — open data, values stored directly
sources.role_in_db: evidence that a species is actually planted in the city; counts, height class and DBH support local_mature_size
data_notes: No date_planted field in the 2026-10-26 snapshot (earlier releases had one) — time_to_intended_size cannot be derived from this source until it returns.
height_m is a banded class, not a measurement: values cluster at 4.6 / 7.6 / 10.7 / 13.7 / 16.8 m (15 / 25 / 35 / 45 / 55 ft midpoints).
cultivar_name 'NONE' means not recorded, not the straight species.

methods.established_proxy: trees without a planting date: DBH >= 20 cm = 'established (DBH >= 20 cm, proxy)'; threshold written into each claim's value.threshold_dbh_cm and context; confidence 0.65, below the 0.75 of age cohorts for trees with date_planted; the two subsets are never combined (methods.md M2)
methods.cultivar_groups: cultivar label with n >= 50 gets its own claim group, context cultivar:'Name'; smaller labels stay in the species-level claims and are listed in their note; unlabelled trees are their own class cultivar:(unrecorded), never merged into a cultivar (methods.md M3)
methods.height_class: height_m is a banded class (15/25/35/45/55 ft midpoints); claims say 'height class' and set value.measure accordingly (methods.md M4)
methods.confidence: presence 0.95, counts 0.9, label frequencies 0.85, DBH 0.8, height class 0.75, age cohort 0.75, established proxy 0.65 (methods.md M1)
